description: This file defines a 'MaterialRequestItem' class inheriting from Document, representing a doctype in the ERPNext system related to stock material requests. It also includes a function to update database indexes upon doctype update.

classes.name: MaterialRequestItem
classes.description: A class representing a material request item within the ERP system, inheriting basic document functionality.

methods.name: on_doctype_update()
methods.description: Function called during doctype updates to add database indexes for 'item_code' and 'warehouse' in 'Material Request Item'.
